data.name: Plinbo: Roguelike Plinko
data.detailed_description:
Plinbo offers a unique gaming experience that blends strategy and luck, where each run lets you choose different card and challenge combinations in a roguelike style.

Each turn:

  • Build your deck through strategic decisions.

  • Take risks by joining challenges.

  • Shape your experience with your choices.

  • Fight to reach the target money.

Endless Strategy and Innovation
With various card and challenge combinations, every run offers a new journey and a different strategic challenge.

  • Tarot cards that uniquely shape your experience.

  • High-risk, turn-based challenges.

  • Luck cards that instantly change your game.

Some cards keep you standing in the early game… others shine in the late stages. Some will always be by your side.
Find the best synergy with the right combinations.

Relaxing and Enjoyable Atmosphere
The clash of balls, the flying coins, and the activation of cards… Plinbo offers not only intelligence and strategy but also a visual feast.

  • Perfect simualted ball movements, go left or right!

  • Modern retro feel with CRT effect.

  • Satisfying visual and sound effects.

Show your luck and strategy… Prove yourself in the world of Plinbo!

data.short_description: UPGRADE YOUR BALLS! Roguelike meets Plinko! Every choice is a strategy; every run is a unique challenge. Build your deck to tame the balls to your will. Take your chance, craft your fate, and cash in!
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or more
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64 Bit Only
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended
